Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the
equipment inspection I1 which must be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block. Quantity: 1/Unit
The primary function of boiler is
to convert water to steam the design and size of boiler varies widely
according to their intended use, while the type of boiler auxiliary including
fuel burning equipment differs with the manufacture and proposed installation
area boiler can also be called steam generators or steam generating units
The radiant heat natural
convection box type boiler described and is constructed to Babcock & Wilcox
design
The first draft initiated by eng. 
Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general director 
eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, approved by eng. Mohamed El-Tahawy: head 
sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.
This document revised by eng. Nageh 
Soliman Shousha: CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. 
Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS 
coordinator.
Safety Precautions
Work order must be issued and the
qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Wear safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.

qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

 surrounding the work area is required.

Standard 
 tool set

Work
to be Carried Out
In accordance with annual boiler outage schedule tasks refer to document no. AA001-12
Check all drain line and valves from the
steam generator and associated piping
Ensure that all steam threads on manual
and motor operated drain valves are clean and lubricated and repair or change 
any of the valves that do not work perfectly.
